title: Israeli forces storm Nasser Hospital in Khan Younis
body:
On 15 February 2024, Israeli forces stormed Nasser Hospital in Khan Younis, the largest health facility in southern Gaza, which had been besieged for about three weeks. Gaza's Health Ministry said Israeli troops forced 95 medics, 191 patients and 165 displaced people into an old building in the compound, with no water, food or milk for children. Fuel was expected to run out within 24 hours, and six patients were on ventilators.

The Israeli army said Hamas was using the compound to hold captives, but provided no evidence, according to Al Jazeera. Hamas denied this. The military said it opened a secure route for civilians to leave, while witnesses and the medical charity MSF said people were afraid to leave after reports of shootings. MSF said one of its employees was unaccounted for and another had been detained. The Health Ministry said Israeli forces damaged two ambulances and stormed the maternity ward.

The World Health Organization described Nasser as critical for all of Gaza, and director-general Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus said he was alarmed. Gaza's Health Ministry reported at least 28,663 killed and 68,395 wounded since 7 October. Al Jazeera cited its own tally, based on official Israeli figures, of at least 1,139 killed in the 7 October attacks. By 18 February the WHO said the hospital was no longer functional.
